description: Friends, it is with a heavy heart that we say until we meet again to Lorraine Loomis, Chair of the Northwest Indian Fisheries Commission. Lorraine passed earlier today surrounded by those she loved most, and she will be incredibly missed by so many of us.

title: Rest Easy, Chairwoman Loomis – Re-Elect Rep. Debra Lekanoff
